## Problem
docs/experiments/escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md:92 still lists ci-gate-compat as one of three open criterion recommendations. That criterion was REJECTED by operator decision 2026-08-19 (ticket 6f2e-58a5, force-closed unimplemented, Gerrit change 1919 abandoned): when a new hard-fail gate breaks an in-flight branch, the remedy is rebase on origin/main + fix the actual failure; a grandfathering criterion institutionalises working around gates. The operator reaffirmed 2026-08-21: repeatedly rejected, must stop reading as an open recommendation (it caused story 5bca-4ca9 to resurface it).

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] The ci-gate-compat bullet in docs/experiments/escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md is amended in place to record the rejection: decision, date, rationale (rebase-and-fix), and a pointer to ticket 6f2e-58a5 — so no future reader re-proposes it.
- [x] The import-integrity recommendation bullet is left byte-for-byte untouched (checked: `git diff` shows no hunk touching it).
- [x] The surface-parity recommendation bullet is left byte-for-byte untouched (checked: `git diff` shows no hunk touching it).
- [x] Doc-only change: `git diff --stat` touches only docs/experiments/escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md.

## Testing
Doc-only change; no code paths affected. Verification:
- `git diff --stat origin/main` shows exactly one changed file: docs/experiments/escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md.
- `grep -n "ci-gate-compat" docs/experiments/escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md` shows the amended bullet records REJECTED, 2026-08-19, rebase-and-fix rationale, and ticket 6f2e-58a5.
- CI (`Verified` gate) passes on the Gerrit change, confirming lint/docs gates are unaffected.
